name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Design AI can speed up drawing a chip. It doesn't replace the rest of the stack: SerDes, networking, packaging, co-designing with the hyperscaler. Google's TPU is still built with Broadcom, not instead of it. Fabless was never just drawing chips.

Monday was rotation, not everything moving together. NVDA down while AVGO bounced says it plainly enough. One day doesn't make a trend though, and AVGO is still under its 20-day line. Divergence worth watching, nothing more yet.
谷歌第八代 TPU 一次出了两款：8tx 主攻机密推理，8i Max 主攻超大上下文。关键是这两款都是现有硅片重新配置，不算新芯片，瞄准的也是谷歌自己的推理负载。TPU 扩得越快，帮谷歌做芯片的博通受益越直接。周一 $AVGO 涨 8.8% 到 319.48 美元，不过还在 20 日均线下方，先当超跌反弹看。
